prompt: Landscape 1440x1000 high-fidelity SaaS admin overview screen comp, the familiar category-standard dashboard for Showoff Admin Portal after server-side platform_admin access succeeds. Plain modern dashboard, white canvas, standard blue #2563eb, ink #111827, pale-gray cards and dividers, generous whitespace, simple left navigation rail and a clean title. This is a usable screen, not a poster, no fake browser frame. Left navigation: SHOWOFF ADMIN, OVERVIEW, TENANTS, SUPPORT, PROVIDER HEALTH, SETTINGS. Main heading OVERVIEW. Three horizontal status panels TENANTS, SUPPORT, PROVIDER HEALTH. Each panel contains the same truthful unavailable state: UNAVAILABLE; No operational data is connected yet. Header at top right says DATA CONNECTIONS / NOT CONNECTED. No sample tenant, support case, incidents, usage, counts, health, chart, timestamps, system status values, named provider or other invented data. No fake completeness. Every visual marker should be a standard empty state with a subtle outline icon; labels and shape reinforce unavailable state, color is not the only cue. Visible words permitted exactly: SHOWOFF ADMIN, OVERVIEW, TENANTS, SUPPORT, PROVIDER HEALTH, SETTINGS, DATA CONNECTIONS, NOT CONNECTED, UNAVAILABLE, No operational data is connected yet. No added decorative copy. Familiar, direct, high-quality admin interface with clear hierarchy and accessible controls.
